newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 4.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The two British nurses accused of killing their Australian colleague in Saudi Arabia are to be tried soon.
- Trade between Germany and United Arab Emirates was worth 2.4 billion marks in 1996.
- Former Hamas leader Abu Marzouk due to arrive in Jordan within 48 hours, Hamas spokesman says.
- UAE's oil minister expects oil prices to reach $20 per barrel before the end of 1997.
- Saudi Arabia's commerce minister orders the setting up of a tourism company with a capital of 100 million riyals.
